lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrTlO₃ (Sr₄Tl₄O₁₂ per cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms across 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Sr centers a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors (3.06–3.28 Å), while Tl centers show 9 O neighbors (2.50–3.08 Å). Corner-, edge-, and face-sharing is observed among the 12-vertex Sr polyhedra and among the 9-vertex Tl polyhedra, with Tl and Sr polyhedra also sharing corners and edges; the neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component.
